description: This file defines a Qwik component called NoteEditor, which provides a user interface for editing or creating notes with title and content. It manages form state, validation, and event handling for submitting or cancelling note edits.

methods.name: submit$
methods.description: Handles form submission, performs validation, and triggers the onSubmit callback with note data.

methods.name: onTitleInput$
methods.description: Updates the title state based on user input.

methods.name: onContentInput$
methods.description: Updates the content state based on user input.

methods.name: cancel$
methods.description: Handles cancellation by invoking the onCancel callback.
